_comment: pose.js computeHorseDepths(). The horse does NOT use one depth for the whole body: it
splits into a near half and a far half from the isometrically tilted leg Y, so the near
half draws over the far half as it turns.  base 'front' = y_adjust*100, base 'back' =
facing_down ? 100 : 0.  'leg' adds 3 to whichever leg of a pair is furthest from camera,
which is what stops the two z-fighting.  Head, neck and tail are the only parts that
rearrange on facing_down -- hence the differing down/up values.
tint is empty: the horse has no appearance slots, so every bone falls through to plain.
iso: two corrections to what the rig records, both verified against obj_horse/Step_0.gml.
flat  - bones that do NOT take the extra -1 when facing_down. The tail is drawn at a
plain y in BOTH branches (:803, :845); pose.js gives it -1 when facing down.
body_middle is the reverse case and is handled by the renderer: it takes the
-1 as well as its half tilt (:812 `y - 1 - 0.5*y_adjust`), which pose.js omits.
legAmp - the rig records 2 because obj_horse computes `y_adjust_leg = 2*dsin(...)` at
:702, but that local is never read again. It is dead code in the game, so the
legs get no extra tilt and pose.js applying one is a divergence.
shadow: obj_horse/Step_0.gml:963-969 pins two spr_player_shadow instances to the DRAWN
body halves, +25 in y; scale and alpha from obj_horse/Draw_0.gml:10-12.
gait: obj_horse/Step_0.gml:634-636 idles on sq_horse_idle_state, not sq_horse_idle.
offset, not direction-dependent. obj_camera/Step_0.gml:59 uses the same -19. (A cow
iso.groundX: rig-space x of the back and front hoof columns (sq_horse_idle_state frame 0,
the leg *down joints sit at x -5 and +26). The cast-shadow baseline tilts through the
ground rows of those two columns (anim_shadow_ground), because the front legs are in
the iso `front` list: their hooves ride the full tilt and stand on a DIFFERENT screen
row than the back hooves at most facings. A level baseline reads that as height and
casts it along the light ray, detaching the front-leg shadows.
mount: moved OUT of this file and into horse.rig.json, alongside isoTilt -- it is rig data the editor edits and saves, not a demo-local tweak.
